# API Contract Requirements Quality Checklist: Path do endpoint de imagens de produto

**Purpose**: Validate the *quality* of the contract requirements for T-002-1 — completeness, clarity, consistency, and scope integrity — before `/speckit-plan` builds on them
**Created**: 2026-07-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Depth**: Standard · **Audience**: Reviewer (PR) · **Companion to**: [requirements.md](./requirements.md) (spec-level quality gate)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. It tests whether the requirements are *written* well — not whether the YAML works.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all constituent parts of the Path Item deliverable enumerated (address, path-level `parameters`, `summary`, `description`)? [Completeness, Spec §Decisão de escopo]
- [x] CHK002 Is the required shape of the `productId` parameter fully specified (name, location, requiredness, description, type, format)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Are the mandatory content elements of the Path Item `description` enumerated rather than left to the author's discretion? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK004 Is it specified whether the Path Item carries a `tags` declaration, given every existing operation in the document is tagged? [Gap]
- [x] CHK005 Is the intended placement of the new Path Item relative to the two existing paths specified, or deliberately left unconstrained? [Gap]
- [x] CHK006 Are requirements stated for what must NOT change, not only for what is added? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [x] CHK007 Is "URL-only reference" defined precisely enough that a reader cannot mistake it for "server accepts a file and returns a URL"? [Clarity, Spec §Decisões do usuário]
- [x] CHK008 Can FR-004's requirement that the description "explicitar a semântica URL-only" be objectively judged as met or unmet? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK009 Is the validation authority for "OpenAPI 3.1 válido" named as a concrete, runnable check rather than an abstract claim of validity? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK010 Is SC-001 ("localiza o endereço por inspeção direta") stated in terms that a reviewer can adjudicate without user testing? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK011 Are the terms "aditiva" and "intacto" defined sharply enough to settle whether reordering or reformatting existing YAML would violate FR-007? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]

- [x] CHK016 Is the resource-plural form (`/images`) reconciled with the PRD's `images[]` array attribute? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK017 Is the resource-oriented naming (`/images`) versus the task's action-oriented wording ("upload") reconciled explicitly? [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Evaluation Result (2026-07-25)

Ran against `spec.md` at generation time. **34 of 38 passed on first read; 4 failed and drove spec edits.** All 38 pass after the edits below.

| Item | Finding | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| CHK030 | **Most substantive.** Constitution Principle VI requires `hasRole('admin')` on mutating endpoints. Operations on this path *are* mutations, but the spec addressed only authentication (`bearerAuth`) and was silent on role — leaving a reader unable to tell whether the omission was deliberate or overlooked. | Added an Edge Case documenting the deferral, its precedent (T-001-5), and the live obligation on T-002-2 / T-005; added a matching Out of Scope entry. Deferral is correct — a Path Item cannot express a role requirement — but it must be *stated*. |
| CHK004 | Spec was silent on `tags`. | Added **FR-010**: `tags` is an operation-level field in OpenAPI 3.1, so its absence is conformance, not omission. Belongs to T-002-2. |
| CHK011 | "aditiva"/"intacto" (FR-007) were not sharp enough to settle whether reformatting existing YAML would violate the requirement. | Rewrote FR-007 with an objective diff-based criterion: every pre-existing line appears as context, none as `+`/`-`. |
| CHK005 | File placement of the new Path Item unspecified. | Added an assumption: appended after the `/stock` path, with the explicit note that YAML mapping order is semantically irrelevant and the convention exists only to minimise the diff. |

No item was waived. No unresolved ambiguity blocks `/speckit-plan`.

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Items marked `[Gap]` had no spec reference at generation time — they were the candidates most likely to need a spec edit, and three of the four failures came from that set.
- This checklist validates requirement *writing quality*. Contract correctness is proven separately by the module build (FR-008) and consumer regression (FR-009).
